name: Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur
short_description: A 252-room Park Hyatt occupying the upper floors of Merdeka 118, the world's second-tallest building, with a 30-metre infinity pool on Level 99.
ai_summary: Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur occupies levels 75 to 114 of Merdeka 118, the world's second-tallest building, with guest rooms starting at a generous 53 square metres and floor-to-ceiling windows framing the Petronas Twin Towers and city skyline. Guests consistently describe the views as incredible from every room, alongside a standout pool and a high-quality breakfast spread. As one of the newest ultra-luxury openings in the city, some early reviews note visible wear and tear despite the recent opening, and the surrounding area remains under active development with limited nearby attractions.

faqs.question: How high up is Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur?
faqs.answer: The hotel occupies levels 75 to 114 of Merdeka 118, the world's second-tallest building, with guest rooms on levels 100 to 112 -- giving nearly every room uninterrupted views over the city, including the Petronas Twin Towers.

faqs.question: Is the area around Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur developed yet?
faqs.answer: Not fully -- the Merdeka 118 precinct is still under active development, so guests should expect fewer nearby shops, restaurants, and attractions within walking distance than at more established Kuala Lumpur luxury hotels for now.
